title: Pro-etale Tor amplitude and bounded flat model
statement: Let $X : \mathrm{Scheme}^{u}$ and let $\mathcal A : \mathrm{Type}\,u'$ be a concrete Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] whose morphisms and underlying sets lie in universe $u+1$. Assume $\mathcal A$ has a symmetric monoidal closed structure, the tensor product is additive in both variables, and $\mathcal A$ admits functorial flat resolutions. Use $\mathcal A$-valued sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site], and the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] $D(\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal A))$. Let $a\le b$ be integers and $K$ an object of this derived category satisfying the etale-origin bounded constructibility predicate [def-sf-categorical-proetale-constructibility]. Then $K$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ in the categorical sense [def-sf-categorical-proetale-tor-amplitude] if and only if there exists a cochain complex $P$ of $\mathcal A$-valued pro-etale sheaves such that every $P^q$ is flat (tensoring with it preserves monomorphisms), $P^q$ is zero whenever $q<a$ or $b<q$, and $K$ is isomorphic to $Q(P)$ in the derived category. Here $Q$ is localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms. Bounded constructibility here means precisely the source's etale-origin predicate; no identification with the intrinsic finite-torsion constructibility predicate is asserted for arbitrary coefficients.

statement_change.old_statement: Let A be a commutative ring, let X be a scheme, let a b : ℤ with a ≤ b, and let K be an object of the derived category of sheaves of A-modules on the small pro-etale site of X such that K is bounded constructible. Then K has Tor amplitude in [a,b] if and only if there exists a cochain complex P of such sheaves with every term flat, with P^q zero for q outside [a,b], and with K isomorphic to the image of P in the derived category. Here the site and bounded constructibility are as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and Tor amplitude is [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].
statement_change.what: The node changed the source coefficient category into a commutative ring and silently identified the source etale-origin boundedConstructible with def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, which is intrinsic and defined only at specified finite-torsion coefficient rings. Its cited finite-Tor node also does not supply the arbitrary-coefficient categorical interval predicate. Reading the full source binders and Constructible.lean shows explicit concrete Grothendieck abelian, symmetric monoidal closed, additive tensor and functorial-flat-resolution assumptions. Correct the internal source-attachment node to that exact source statement, preserving every conclusion and all source cases; do not narrow the theorem to finite rings or assert an unproved encoding identification.
